Definition: to go (causatively, bring) out, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, direct and proxim.
BiblicalUsage: 1) to go out, come out, exit, go forth; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to go or come out or forth, depart; 1a2) to go forth (to a place); 1a3) to go forward, proceed to (to or toward something); 1a4) to come or go forth (with purpose or for result); 1a5) to come out of; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to cause to go or come out, bring out, lead out; 1b2) to bring out of; 1b3) to lead out; 1b4) to deliver; 1c) (Hophal) to be brought out or forth
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
